messages:
lina (Sales): Hey team, Aster Capital POC kicked off today. They hit bad first-token latency on a 1k prompt — reported ~1.2s TTFT, goal is <300ms. They're on Redwood Hosted with our standard prefill policy. Can we swarm?
sam (SE): Thanks Lina. Any logs or example request IDs? Also which model/variant and region?
lina (Sales): customer sent request id `req_20260321_0420` and said model `redwood-3b-std` in us-west-2. They used single-shot generation, temp 0.2, typical seq len ~1k.
mike (Support): I pulled the logs for req_20260321_0420 — see snippet: ```INFO request=req_20260321_0420 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-3b-std shard=gw-12 latency_first_token_ms=1186 kv_cache_hit=false batch_id=0``` Seems kv_cache_hit=false and batch_id=0 (no batching).
tariq (Eng Oncall): kv_cache miss + batch_id 0 explains it. For long seqs served cold, we expect higher TTFT but 1.2s is high. Two questions: are they sending prefill/persistent connection? and what prefill size?
lina (Sales): they said using single request per user, no keepalive, default prefill. Also asked about pricing if we suggest persistent connections / reserved capacity.
sam (SE): For this workload we recommend either enabling prefill (small prefix warmup) or persistent TLS keepalive + streaming to amortize handshake + warm KV. Suggested config: prefill_policy=prefix, prefill_tokens=128, keepalive=true. That often drops TTFT to ~200-300ms on these models.
jane (Security): Aster's security questionnaire also flagged KMS + VPC egress. If we propose persistent connections / Dedicated nodes, they want HSM/KMS integration and an on-prem option. Can sales get me the questionnaire doc?
lina (Sales): sent questionnaire PDF to jane via email. They're also asking for E2E encryption of cache entries.
tariq (Eng Oncall): KV cache entries are encrypted at rest by default in hosted; for Dedicated we can offer customer-managed keys. To troubleshoot now, can we reproduce? Sam, can you run a quick synthetic with same seq length and prefill disabled?
sam (SE): Running curl against our staging endpoint with identical params. Output: ```curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-std","input":"<1k tokens>","prefill":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` Running now...
deploy-bot: deployment staging/serve-redwood-3b-std-2026-03-21 succeeded in 34s.
sam (SE): Result: first-token latency 1.18s, batch_id=0, kv_cache_hit=false — reproduces. If I enable prefill_tokens=128: first-token drops to 240ms.
mike (Support): Customer also saw occasional 429s during spikes when they concurrently sent a burst of small requests. We should check rate limits and batching conflicts — they are on bursty traffic pattern from their crawler.
tariq (Eng Oncall): 429s + batch_id 0 likely due to concurrent single-request flow causing contention on worker. Short term: enable client-side batching / request coalescing or route them to Dedicated pool with reserved concurrency. Long term: we can tune autoscale policy and increase per-customer concurrency limit.
lina (Sales): For pricing: how do we price Dedicated for this POC (expected peak 60 RPS, median 15 RPS)? They asked for monthly commit and an estimate for 99th perc latency SLA.
sam (SE): I'll prepare a rough quote: Dedicated small pool (4x A100-equivalent) with reserved concurrency should hit 99th <400ms for these sequences; I'll loop in pricing. Also propose a short-term workaround: enable prefill and keepalive for hosted + increase soft rate limit for the POC for 48 hours.
jane (Security): One more: they asked whether enabling prefill touches customer data retention. Prefill uses only prompt content transiently; we can set retention=0 and no logs persist. I'll draft language for the questionnaire.
mike (Support): I'll propose escalation playbook to the customer: 1) Turn on prefill_tokens=128, 2) Use HTTP keepalive + streaming, 3) Apply short term rate bump, 4) If still bad, move to Dedicated trial. I'll paste a minimal config snippet: ```{
  "prefill_policy": "prefix",
  "prefill_tokens": 128,
  "connection": {"keepalive": true, "streaming": true}
}```
sam (SE): Agreed. I'll send them a quick repro guide and the staging latency numbers. Lina — can you ask them to enable keepalive and run one overnight test?
lina (Sales): On it. I'll CC Mike and Jane. Thanks team — will update thread when Aster runs the overnight test. :thumbsup:
